intent: Report estate field capacity using the field schedule maximum while leaving hive capacity and all pricing behavior unchanged.
rationale: GameStateService.estate currently populates EstateResponse.maxFields with EstatePrices.MAX_HIVES. EstatePrices defines a distinct MAX_FIELDS constant for the field schedule, so replacing only that mismatched constant is the smallest causal repair for the stated symptom.
public_checks: Inspected the supplied GameStateServiceTest, EstatePrices, EstateResponse, and GameStateService source relevant to the public symptom.
Verified proposal.patch applies cleanly to the exact supplied parent with VERIFY_OUTPUT.py.
